title: JAMEL estimate payload (v2)
description: Input contract for generate_wycena_xlsx.py. Supports two pricing modes: 'range' (widełki min/max, columns RH min/max + Kwota min/max, formulas =F*H/=G*H) and 'fixed' (single RH/Kwota, =F*G). Core items render on the 'Wycena' sheet; optional upsells (additional_items) render on 'Elementy dodatkowe' with the same layout.

title.description: Middle segment of the two-line sheet title: 'Wycena {title}\ndla {client_name}'. Default for websites: 'wdrożenia serwisu'.

date.description: Optional offer date DD.MM.YYYY ('Data przygotowania oferty'). Defaults to today.

default_hourly_rate.description: Fallback rate when neither the item, role_rates nor the built-in JAMEL rate card resolves the role.

pricing_mode.description: 'range' = widełki min/max (default for first contact / integration risk); 'fixed' = cena stała (simple brochure sites).

role_rates.description: Per-role rate overrides (PLN netto/h) on top of the built-in JAMEL rate card.

stages.description: Explicit stage order for the 'Wycena' sheet. Stages listed here render a banner even with zero items (e.g. 'Zakończenie prac' as a closing banner). Stages found only in items are appended in first-appearance order.

line_items.description: Core scope — everything the client asked for. Rendered on the 'Wycena' sheet.

additional_items.description: JAMEL upsell proposals outside core scope. Rendered on the 'Elementy dodatkowe' sheet (omitted when empty).

stage.description: Stage banner text, e.g. 'Analiza i projektowanie', 'Programowanie', 'Prace redakcyjne, testy, analityka, wdrożenie', 'Zakończenie prac'.

kind.description: 'hourly' = RH × rate; 'fixed' = ryczałt (literal amount, '-' in RH/Stawka; negative amount = rabat); 'included' = 'w cenie' (visible row, zero cost).

hours.description: kind=hourly, pricing_mode=fixed. Also optional for kind=included in range mode (shown hours at zero rate).

amount.description: kind=fixed, pricing_mode=fixed. Literal PLN netto; negative = discount (Rabat).

hourly_rate.description: Optional per-item rate override; kind=hourly only.
